name: pi-harness-lite
description: Personal TUI customization plugin for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Changes Codex startup chrome, theme, diffs, and status line.
interface.longDescription: Pi Harness Lite demonstrates Codex TUI plugin hooks with a quiet startup, Ghostty theme sync, a focused last-changed-file diff view, a minimal footer, and a status line focused on run state, model, git branch, context, and current directory.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Pi Harness Lite to customize the Codex TUI status line.
